youtube_title: 'Your Parcel Is Held by Customs' Call? It's a Scam #Shorts
youtube_description:
Scam of the Week #2. A call says your parcel is held at Customs with drugs inside and you must pay to clear the case. Then you're 'transferred' to fake police with a fake ID and fake FIR to scare you.
Indian Customs (CBIC) has said its officers never contact the public by phone, SMS or email to collect duty into private accounts. Real Customs communications carry a DIN that you can verify on the CBIC website. Got this call? Cut it, then call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: CBIC / Indian Customs advisory (PIB, 16 Jun 2024).

Call aaya: 'Aapka parcel customs mein pakda gaya, andar drugs hain, paise bharo' 🚨 Phir 'police' ko transfer, fake ID, fake FIR — bas darr.
Sahi jawab: CALL KAATO. Customs khud bolta hai — unke officers phone/SMS pe duty nahi maangte, personal account mein toh kabhi nahi. Asli notice pe DIN hota hai, CBIC site pe check karo. Report: 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in
